parts.note_add: JATCO family: 3 = speeds, N = Nissan design, 71 = 71 mm gear spacing, B = second version; the type plate with assembly and serial number sits on the right side of the case on Nissan units - check where the Mazda plate is (the catalogue splits parts at transmission serial 500076 and 626754). Aftermarket overhaul kits are sold under the Nissan L3N71B name (Cobra 53002F, Transtec). Nissan's 1976 280Z Section AT for the same unit is saved under datasheets/PT054.
Catalogue 3900A-1 row 39-380 is MEMBER, TRANSMISSION MOUNTING: 1480-39-380A for M/T, 1481-39-380B for A/T (S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.102) - it is the transmission crossmember.
Genuine 1011-39-340A still sold by Atkins Rotary ($62, in stock 2026-09), listed 74-85; Atkins warns it does not fit 84-85 automatics, but the 81-83 catalogue gives this one number for M/T and A/T.
Atkins: upper 0884-39-385A NLA, lower 0884-39-384A out of stock; studs 1013-39-382A to serial 626754, F001-39-372 from 626755 (S-005 p.102). The later insulators were not found for sale.

Catalogue OCR reads the number as 'ga72-19-444B' (S-005 Body PDF p.95), consistent with 8872- like the transmission 8872-19-090B. 4-pin connector A-06: BY/BW starter interlock (closed in P and N), GY/RW back-up lamps (closed in R). No new or aftermarket replacement found (Atkins lists none before 1986).
Single BR wire (connector B-33), earthed through its body; fed from the kick-down switch under the accelerator via the 15 A fuse. Test: audible click on 12 V. No replacement listing found.
Mark converter and drive plate before removal and refit on the marks (S-045 7A:18).
Gear-and-crescent pump; inner and outer gears are replaced as a set; mark the gears' top faces before removal (S-045 7A:10).
Aftermarket 3N71B front pump seal 42 x 60 x 9 mm (metal clad) sold under the Nissan name; check against the removed seal.
Catalogue OCR reads the 8U01-19-257 quantity as 1 (S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.62); check.
ATF found inside the vacuum pipe means the vacuum diaphragm has failed (S-002 7B-16).
The line-pressure test port is at the right rear of the case (S-045 7A:18).
Genuine 0437-17-335A still sold (Mazdatrix $11.63, 71-85 auto and manual); aftermarket Mazda-size 3N71B extension seal 35 x 48 x 15 mm.

The washer 0338-19-388A and nut 0338-19-389 sit between the piston stem 19386 and the servo retainer in the catalogue list (S-005 p.64), and the band is adjusted at the servo piston stem with its lock nut (S-038 T:7, S-045 7A:17), so they belong to the stem; the anchor-end bolt is the fixed band anchor, not the adjuster.
Piston comes out with compressed air into the oil passage (S-045 7A:9). Adjustment is at the stem: 12-15 Nm, back off two turns, lock nut 15-40 Nm.
'81 model up to transmission serial FB331-500075 used 8562-17-441A; 8057-17-441C from 500076 (S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.64).
Genuine 1011-17-442A still sold by Atkins Rotary ($28, in stock 2026-09).
